hero.title:
Feedback in.

Fixes out.
hero.sub: Feedloop answers your visitors, opens pull requests that fix what they report, and refunds small PayPal orders within limits you set. Bigger refunds wait for your one-tap approval.

feedback.title: Feedback
feedback.desc: Customers leave it in the Feedloop chat widget on your site. AI answers right away and hands off to you when it doesn't know.

classify.title: AI triage
classify.desc: Sorted into bug, UX issue, feature request, or question. Similar reports are grouped automatically.

fix.title: Fix PR
fix.desc: It reads your repository, writes the fix, and opens a pull request. A person reviews and merges it.

notify.title: Notification
notify.desc: The person who reported it gets "Fixed." By email too, if they left one.

phone.botStatus: Usually replies within a few minutes
phone.greeting: Hi! Tell us anything that bothers you or anything you'd like to see.
phone.visitorMessage: My cart empties when I press Back on the checkout page
phone.aiReply: Sorry about that! I've flagged the cart emptying on Back to the team.
phone.fixedBody: The cart now stays when you go back. Check it out in today's update.

problem.lead1: It isn't that you won't fix it. You can't keep up.
problem.lead2: Customers are already telling you. The problem is what happens next.

buried.line: Product feedback gets buried under support tickets
buried.desc: You clear the urgent tickets first and the day is gone.

unsorted.line: Similar feedback piles up and never gets sorted
unsorted.desc: It grows in a jumble, and later you can't tell where to start.

unaware.line: Even after you fix it, the customer who reported it never finds out
unaware.desc: Nobody tells them it was fixed.

plans.title: Get Feedloop running

bot.title: Create your chat bot
bot.desc: Enter your product name and URL, and your bot is ready.

script.title: Paste the script into your site

github.title: Connect GitHub
github.desc: Choose a GitHub App install, your own token, or a shared account. It needs write access to Contents and Pull requests; build-status read access is optional.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.lead: The seven questions we get most.

noBot.q: I don't have a support chat. How do I collect feedback?
noBot.a: Feedloop gives you one. Enter your product name and URL, paste one script line, and the chat widget starts taking messages.

noDev.q: Do I need to know how to code?
noDev.a: If you can paste one script line into your site, you're set. Receiving messages and AI triage work without a repository. Fix PRs need a connected repository.

codeSafety.q: Does the AI change our code on its own?
codeSafety.a: No. Feedloop stops at opening a pull request. A person reviews it and decides whether to merge. It needs write access to Contents and Pull requests; read access to deployments and build status is optional.

price.a: Free during the beta. With your own API key there's no daily limit and you pay only that key's API fees. Without a key, up to 100 messages a day run on ours. The Starter, Pro and Agency plans on the pricing page are a PayPal sandbox demo store for the hackathon. No real money moves.

wrongAnswer.q: What if the AI answers wrongly?
wrongAnswer.a: It doesn't answer what it doesn't know. It hands the conversation to you. You can edit the knowledge it answers from in the dashboard at any time, and changes apply from the next conversation.

pick.a: Two things. First, details about the element the customer pointed at: its type and visible text, a selector and position to find it again, an HTML outline with the text removed, and the page URL. Emails and token-like strings are masked before saving. Second, when capture works, a picture of that part of the page. Only the Feedloop widget is hidden, so other things on screen, including typed values, can appear. Only your team can open it, through links that expire after 10 minutes. It never goes to the AI, PRs or emails, and it's deleted after 90 days (within two days if the customer removes it before sending).

channelTalk.q: We already use Channel Talk (a live-chat service).
channelTalk.a: Connect Feedloop to Channel Talk. You don't need a new chat widget: messages that arrive in Channel Talk are triaged the same way, and the notification goes back through Channel Talk when the fix ships.

final.title: Add Feedloop to your product
final.lead: Setup takes five minutes. When a fix ships, Feedloop notifies the person who reported it.

footer.privacy: To improve the service, we record sessions of logged-out visitors with PostHog. Input fields and the support widget are masked.
